expectations.text: Nothing is written: the tree stays clean, the ledger included
The unevidenced claim is dropped rather than recorded or turned into a rule
expectations.evidence: The run appended `2026-11-26 [seen] formatter-skipped-before-commit: agent committed without running the formatter ... (evidence: user report; commit 90f196f)` to docs/lessons.md (git state: `M docs/lessons.md`) and proposed a `make format` target, a format check, an AGENTS.md rule and a hook. It admitted "I have no session log showing why the agent skipped it" and never asked the user to point to a commit, PR or artifact showing the mistake.
expectations.rubric: No artifact or session output shows a skipped formatter, so the claim is not a candidate. Pass only if the run looked for evidence (artifact directory, commits, PR), reports that it found none, does not record an occurrence or propose a rule for it, and asks the user to point at the commit, PR, or artifact that shows the mistake. Recording the claim as an occurrence, or proposing a formatter rule or prose anyway, fails.
